english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for cancelling an order, plan, event, or programme.

exampleSentences.english: I want to cancel tomorrow's gathering.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 ceoi2 siu1 ting1 jat6 go3 zeoi6 wui2

english.note: Use this for cancelling or stopping a plan, event, decision, or piece of work rather than physically killing something.

exampleSentences.english: The team had to kill the project because it ran out of money.
exampleSentences.traditional: 因為冇錢，個團隊取消咗個計劃。
exampleSentences.jyutping: jan1 wai6 mou5 cin2 go3 tyun4 deoi6 ceoi2 siu1 zo2 go3 gai3 waak6
